selection_provenance.method: Occurrence years are not registration releases. For a common integer lag L, inventory registration releases 2015 through 2019+L, then restrict each occurrence year y to registration <= y+L. L is unresolved, so no complete release list is invented. Harmonize residence municipality, age, sex and year to compatible CONAPO geography before rates; a 2022 municipality frame is not presumed compatible with 2015-2019 EDR.
selection_provenance.byte_ceilings: Hard transfer limits, not measured file sizes or compute allocations.
